question: How much did I spend on taxis last month?
title: Last month

cells.title: One kind of spending in the last full month
cells.code:
KEY = "§THING§"
COL, VALS = {"taxi": ["kind", ["taxi"]], "fuel": ["kind", ["fuel", "service_station"]], "parking": ["kind", ["parking"]], "public": ["kind", ["public_transport"]], "fastfood": ["kind", ["fast_food"]], "bars": ["kind", ["bar"]], "eating": ["category", ["Restaurants"]], "groceries": ["category", ["Groceries"]], "clothes": ["kind", ["clothing"]], "cinema": ["kind", ["cinema"]], "events": ["kind", ["events"]], "pharmacy": ["kind", ["pharmacy"]], "doctor": ["kind", ["doctor"]], "dentist": ["kind", ["dentist"]], "electronics": ["kind", ["electronics"]], "furniture": ["kind", ["furniture"]], "hotels": ["kind", ["hotel"]], "flights": ["kind", ["flight"]], "travel": ["category", ["Travel"]], "shopping": ["category", ["Lifestyle"]], "fun": ["category", ["Entertainment"]], "transport": ["category", ["Transportation"]], "health": ["category", ["Health"]], "utilities": ["category", ["Utilities"]], "housing": ["category", ["Housing"]], "sports": ["kind", ["sports"]]}[KEY]
NAME = {"taxi": "taxis", "fuel": "fuel and service stations", "parking": "parking", "public": "public transport", "fastfood": "fast food", "bars": "bars", "eating": "eating out", "groceries": "groceries", "clothes": "clothes", "cinema": "the cinema", "events": "events and concerts", "pharmacy": "the pharmacy", "doctor": "doctors", "dentist": "the dentist", "electronics": "electronics", "furniture": "furniture", "hotels": "hotels", "flights": "flights", "travel": "trips", "shopping": "shopping", "fun": "fun", "transport": "getting around", "health": "health", "utilities": "utilities", "housing": "housing", "sports": "sports gear"}[KEY]
MON = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
months = list(last12)
last = months[-1]
mask = tx["is_spend"] & tx[COL].isin(VALS)
d = tx[mask & tx["month"].isin(months)]
by = d.groupby("month")["spend"].agg(["sum", "count"]).reindex(months, fill_value=0)
amt, n = round(float(by.loc[last, "sum"]), 2), int(by.loc[last, "count"])
um = kori.usual_month()
if COL == "category":                                   # the same usual month the Plan tab shows for this category
    usual = round(float(um["categories"].get(VALS[0], 0.0)), 2)
    USUAL, UW = f"A usual month is {eur(usual)}", "a usual month"
else:                                                   # a part of a category: the same window, the last six full months, and called an average
    usual = round(float(by.loc[list(last6), "sum"].mean()), 2)
    USUAL, UW = f"The last six months averaged {eur(usual)} a month", "a month on average"
year_total = round(float(by["sum"].sum()), 2)
mname = MON[int(last[5:]) - 1]
LBL = {"Housing": "Housing", "Restaurants": "Eating out", "Groceries": "Groceries", "Home & Tech": "Home & tech", "Transportation": "Getting around", "Entertainment": "Fun", "Lifestyle": "Shopping", "Utilities": "Utilities", "Health": "Health", "Travel": "Trips"}
pay = d[d["month"] == last].sort_values("spend", ascending=False).head(5)
rows = [{"what": str(r.merchant) if isinstance(r.merchant, str) and r.merchant else LBL.get(r.category, r.category), "date": str(r.date),
         "amount": round(float(r.spend), 2)} for r in pay.itertuples()]
emit("month_name", mname, "text", "The last full month")
emit("last_month", amt, "eur", "Spent in the last full month")
emit("payments", n, "count", "Payments in the last full month")
emit("usual", usual, "eur_per_month", "A usual month" if COL == "category" else "The average of the last six full months")
emit("usual_word", UW, "text", "What the monthly figure is")
emit("year_total", year_total, "eur", "The last 12 full months together")
table("by_month", [{"short": MON[int(m[5:]) - 1][:3], "label": MON[int(m[5:]) - 1] + " " + m[:4], "spend": round(float(by.loc[m, "sum"]), 2),
                    "count": int(by.loc[m, "count"])} for m in months], "By month, the last 12 full months")
table("payments_list", rows or [{"what": "-", "date": str(today), "amount": 0.0}], "The biggest payments in the last full month")

if amt > 0:
    say(f"You spent **{eur(amt, True)}** on {NAME} in {mname}, in {n} payment{'' if n == 1 else 's'}. {USUAL}.")
elif year_total > 0:
    say(f"You spent **nothing** on {NAME} in {mname}. {USUAL}, and the last 12 months came to {eur(year_total)}.")
else:
    say(f"You spent **nothing** on {NAME} in {mname}, and nothing in the 12 months before it either.")
